subject: cdk_synth
correlation_obligations: The generated CloudFront hostname and default certificate are the only public application endpoint and the distribution reaches the internal ALB through its VPC origin.
ALB rules preserve /raw/mcp and /sdk/mcp for their respective target groups while every unmatched path returns a fixed 404 without forwarding.
Deployed SSE is neither compressed, buffered, nor cached and heartbeat cadence stays below both pinned 60-second hop timeouts.
